items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: Joe Oliver went to Chicago and Joe Oliver sent for him and he went to Chicago

ctx.x: around there before either one of them know how to play. I didn't know how to play anything, I wasn't thinking about music and they wasn't playing anything so finally Baby wanted to learn drums and the father brought them a drum. They was living over in Waverly, Mississippi. In fact that's where they were born, you know everybody says it's New Orleans, but they were born in Waverly, Mississippi, a little town, about six miles. So then Baby started playing the drum and then Johnny got the clarinet and he used to…
You knew that Baby died a month ago.
